svg.title: Data flow in one cycle of a qq loop job
svg.desc: An eight-stage cycle ring with the input directory, the storage archive and the working directory around it. The previous cycle's runtime files are archived, the input directory is copied to the node except the archive, this cycle's archived files are staged in, the script runs, files matching the archive format are moved to the archive, everything else is copied back to the input directory, and the working directory is then removed.
